title: service-datasource: the env-credential reason rides on non-auth connect failures, and a failed connect keeps its collision owner (S1/S2 of #28208's review)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

Filing gate: ② should-fixes a contract review carried out of its PR. These are S1 and S2 of the contract review on PR #28208 (#27687, option 5), comment 6537998014 (PASS). The seat lands #28208 as reviewed and files the two here, so that neither lives only in a merged PR. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3, not dispatched. **Blocked-by: #28208.**

## S1: the "variable not set" reason rides on every connect failure

In `datasource-connection-service.ts`, the `failed-degraded` catch sets `envCredentialVar` whenever the env slot applied and the variable was empty. So a host-unreachable error, a missing driver module (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`) or a TLS failure on a code datasource with no variable set also gains "…reads its credential from OS_DATASOURCE_X_PASSWORD at connect, which is not set on this host". An operator chasing a network fault is sent to set a password first.

Wanted: attach the sentence as a note, or only when the driver's error reads as an authentication refusal. Pin a non-auth failure (unreachable host) whose reason does not lead with the variable. The existing pin "the database refusing the login answers the variable to set" must keep passing.

## S2: a collision owner is recorded before the connect succeeds

`envCredentialOwners.set(variable, name)` runs before the read and the build. A connect that then fails `failed-degraded` keeps the entry, because `handleFailure` does not clear it. A later connect of a different name that derives the same variable is then refused as a collision against a datasource that never connected. Only names outside the schema's `[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*` can collide, so this is a corner of the defensive guard.

Wanted: release the owner on the failure path, or record it only after the build succeeds, with a test.

Size S, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `@objectstack/service-datasource` patch.
